recordedFilesystemEvidence.observationCommand: stat -c "%n | birth=%w | modify=%y | change=%z" <metrics.jsonl>; Python pathlib.stat, sha256 and JSONL step-sequence validation; findmnt --target <metrics.jsonl>
recordedFilesystemEvidence.originalInodeAssessment: Birth, modification and change times are all in the original July training interval, not a later copied November inode; ctime equals mtime.

mechanism: The base model is moved to one CUDA device before entering the SFT loop.
The loop retains the model throughout all steps without offload, unload or resume branches.
metrics.jsonl is created by append-open after the first completed step and written after each subsequent step.
loss.item() precedes each metric append; the final metric records completion of step 720.
sourceEvidence.limitation: The historical run receipt does not pin the Python source commit. Residency is reconstructed from retained pre-run code, matched run/step identities, and original inode timestamps; it is not a hardware-utilization trace.

derivation.rounding: floor to whole seconds, excluding first-step/model-load/tail duration

interpretation: The budget uses a conservative lower bound on one-GPU allocated residency. It does not claim measured GPU active time or the exact complete SFT duration. The 3576.012-second run-contract-to-checkpoint wall interval is not used as the denominator.
protocolAuthority: The frozen 1% numerical criterion is unchanged. Smoke/control charging follows the separately hash-bound pre-model amendment, not this denominator receipt.
